title: Getting Started with LINQ
description: Introduction to LINQ, its purpose, advantages, and the .NET API that powers it.
longDescription: This module introduces you to Language-Integrated Query (LINQ), its history, and why it revolutionized data querying in C#. You'll understand the advantages of LINQ over traditional approaches and explore the .NET API architecture that makes LINQ possible.
whatYouLearn: Understand what LINQ is and its purpose in .NET
Learn the advantages of LINQ over traditional data querying
Explore the LINQ API architecture in .NET
Discover the different LINQ providers and data sources
